title: Bowling Green — the governance record (CRA Resolution 23-01249, the seller-name rezonings, the contested 2026 roll call, the Liames land assembly)
source: Fourteen primary documents from three public bodies, plus one live parcel-layer query and two blocked routes recorded as per-source negatives.
